title: Replace Wireless Mouse Battery
purpose: Restore wireless mouse operation by safely replacing the depleted battery.

steps.title: Turn off the mouse
steps.instruction: Flip the mouse over and slide the power switch to OFF.
steps.check: Switch is in OFF position and sensor light is off.
steps.narration: Step one, I turn the mouse off.

steps.title: Open battery cover
steps.instruction: Hold the mouse steady and slide the rear battery cover off.
steps.check: Cover loosens and separates from mouse body.
steps.narration: Step two, I open the battery cover.

steps.title: Remove old battery
steps.instruction: Pull the old battery out of the compartment.
steps.check: Battery is lifted clear of the compartment.
steps.warning: Avoid touching leaking or corroded contacts.
steps.narration: Step three, I remove the old battery.

steps.title: Inspect polarity markings
steps.instruction: Look into the empty compartment to locate the + and - polarity marks.
steps.check: Compartment is empty, polarity marks visible, cover set aside.
steps.narration: Step four, I check the polarity.

steps.title: Insert new battery
steps.instruction: Place the new AA battery to match the + and - polarity marks.
steps.check: Battery sits flat and secure in the compartment.
steps.narration: Step five, I insert the new battery.

steps.title: Close cover and power on
steps.instruction: Slide the battery cover back until it clicks, then slide the power switch to ON.
steps.check: Cover is flush and sensor light glows.
steps.narration: Step six, I close the cover and turn it on.
